name: Home batteries
description: Small rings for the batteries in the house: the home battery (a Deye inverter through the Solarman integration) with its state of charge, whether it charges, discharges or rests, its work mode and the target of the current time-of-use slot; and the car (Tibber or any integration) with its state of charge, charge limit, range in km and whether it charges or is plugged in. Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: home_device
cell_options.label: Home battery: inverter
cell_options.help: A Deye inverter from the Solarman integration (the device of its Work Mode select). The widget reads its battery, work mode and time-of-use slots. Kept as a secret.

cell_options.name: home_name
cell_options.label: Home battery: name
cell_options.help: Blank: 'Home battery' in the widget's language.

cell_options.name: grid_min_soc
cell_options.label: Grid charging counts from
cell_options.help: A slot set to charge from the grid with a target this low charges nothing; it is not shown as grid charging.

cell_options.name: car_soc
cell_options.label: Car: state of charge
cell_options.help: The car's battery in %. Leave blank for no car. All car sensors are kept as secrets.

cell_options.name: car_range
cell_options.label: Car: range
cell_options.help: In m, km or mi: shown in km.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Language
cell_options.help: The widget's words in this language, whatever the dashboard's. Set the same on every widget of a page for one language throughout.
